objective: Compose bounded insurance presentation and economic fact reads into canonical relationship economics views and delegate final source/campaign/product/state/status/producer aggregation to INS-003H without relationship-at-a-time economic reads.
cohortSemantics: The caller supplies the explicit finite relationship ID cohort. INS-003J does not define all-leads, all-customers, all-policies, date-window, or book-of-business population semantics.
rules: Every requested relationship ID is canonicalized before any persistence read.
Duplicate requested relationship IDs are removed while preserving first-request order.
Empty relationship input returns an empty aggregate projection without any persistence reads.
Returned presentations and facts must belong to the requested relationship cohort.
At most one insurance presentation may exist per requested relationship.
Relationships without insurance presentation remain in the supplied cohort with absent presentation context.
Relationships without economic facts remain in the supplied cohort with an empty canonical economics projection.
Currency isolation, premium-versus-revenue semantics, realized commission, and contribution semantics remain owned by the existing pure analytics layers.
